title: Stochastic Optimal Control of Interacting Particle Systems in Hilbert Spaces and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2511.21646v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimal control of interacting particles governed by stochastic evolution equations in Hilbert spaces is an open area of research. Such systems naturally arise in formulations where each particle is modeled by stochastic partial differential equations, path-dependent stochastic differential equations (such as stochastic delay differential equations or stochastic Volterra integral equations), or partially observed stochastic systems. The purpose of this manuscript is to build a limiting theory as the number of particles tends to infinity via the dynamic programming approach. We prove the convergence of the value functions $u_n$ of finite particle systems to a function $\mathcal{V}$, which is the unique $L$-viscosity solution of the corresponding mean-field Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation in the space of probability measures, and we identify its lift with the value function $U$ of the so-called ``lifted'' limit optimal control p

translated_title: 希尔伯特空间中相互作用粒子系统的随机最优控制及其应用
translated_abstract: 由希尔伯特空间中随机演化方程支配的相互作用粒子的最优控制是一个开放的研究领域。此类系统自然出现在如下情形中：每个粒子由随机偏微分方程、路径依赖的随机微分方程（例如随机时滞微分方程或随机Volterra积分方程）或部分可观测的随机系统来建模。本文的目的是通过动态规划方法建立粒子数目趋于无穷时的极限理论。我们证明了有限粒子系统的值函数 $u_n$ 收敛到一个函数 $\mathcal{V}$，该函数是概率测度空间上相应的平均场Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的唯一 $L$-粘性解，并且我们将其提升（lift）与所谓的“提升”极限最优控制问题的值函数 $U$ 等同起来。
tldr: 本文通过动态规划方法证明了希尔伯特空间中有限粒子系统随机最优控制的值函数收敛于概率测度空间上平均场HJB方程的唯一L-粘性解，并将其与“提升”极限最优控制问题的值函数建立对应关系。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes, via the dynamic programming approach, the convergence of value functions of finite-particle stochastic optimal control systems in Hilbert spaces to the unique L-viscosity solution of the corresponding mean-field Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation on the space of probability measures, which is identified with the value function of the "lifted" limit optimal control problem.
